summary: Re-validation after voice regression fix (mic MediaRecorder->/api/stt and TTS Onyx via Emergent LLM Key fallback). Backend 6/6 pytest passed: TTS->STT round trip (French audio 'Bonjour Sirius, quelle heure est-il' transcribed back containing 'sirius' and 'heure'); STT no-file -> 422; empty file -> 4xx/500 graceful; junk audio -> graceful no-crash; white-label HTML (title=SIRIUS, no emergent-badge, no posthog, no 'Made with Emergent'); /api/chat 'qui t'a créé' answer contains 'partel'. Frontend re-validated against https://cybertech-panel.preview.emergentagent.com: page title SIRIUS, no #emergent-badge in DOM, data-testid='sirius-hud' present, data-testid='sirius-mic-btn' visible & clickable, app does not crash when mic is toggled in a permission-denied environment, and the configuration page submit flow remains intact. The previous iteration_7 already covered the explicit 'Accès au micro refusé' subtitle path; the current run also confirmed no JS console errors and no crash after mic click in headless preview.
critical_code_review_comments: transcribeAndProcess (App.js:681) still swallows fetch errors with bare catch{}. Consider surfacing resp.status to the subtitle (or console.warn) to ease user debugging of mic upload failures.

/api/stt (server.py:128) writes upload to a hardcoded .webm temp file regardless of upload.content_type. Whisper handles mp3/webm interchangeably via the format hint, but propagating the real extension would be more correct.

Frontend setup gate and HUD share the same data-testid='sirius-hud' root (App.js:756), so the testid alone cannot distinguish the two screens. Consider 'sirius-setup' on the configuration page and keep 'sirius-hud' only on the active HUD for more precise e2e assertions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (HUD title, no badge, mic clickable, no crash)

test_credentials: No login required. Backend uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY for Whisper/TTS fallback.
seed_data_creation: TTS-generated mp3 used as STT input in-memory only; chat session_id='TEST_creator' inserted into sirius_chats (negligible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mic data-testid='sirius-mic-btn'. HUD root data-testid='sirius-hud' is shared between configuration page and active HUD (gate component wraps both). Preview browser cannot grant real microphone access; backend STT is verified via TTS->STT round trip in /app/backend/tests/test_sirius_stt.py. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env is the fallback for both /api/tts and /api/stt; both pass with no user-provided openai_key.
